discoveries: Earlier tests that fail under the new rule (DEC-866). I did not edit them.
  - In `tests/unit/install/test_install.py`, all with an orchestrator on ticket T-01 in a project that has no roster: `test_orchestrator_install_gets_ask` (expects ask on `pip install requests`), `test_ask_leaves_snapshot` (expects ask plus a snapshot file in `.gov-runtime/snapshots`), `test_ask_output_has_three_keys` (expects `permissionDecision` ask on `npm install -g ccusage`), `test_unfrozen_repo_asks_install_for_orchestrator` (expects ask without a freeze), and `test_curl_combined_option_ask_for_orchestrator` (expects ask on `curl -fsSLo ~/.local/bin/tool …`).
  - In `tests/acceptance/W1-04`: all 324 errors come from one setup probe, which expects the guard to ask when an orchestrator runs `pip install requests` in a project with no `coordination_ticket` key. The guard now refuses with "roster.yaml does not exist". Nothing in this repository read `roster.yaml` before this change.
risks: Any generated project without `coordination_ticket` in `governance/project/roster.yaml` now refuses every install, the CTO's included, until adoption sets the key. This is fail-closed by design, but the adopt flow and EXAMIN's roster need the key. The rule finds the session's ticket by file name or `wbs_id`, like `_load_ticket`, and also removes quotes around a `wbs_id` value.
lessons: W1-38/W1-39 take about 17 minutes, longer than one 600-second foreground call. The W1-04 errors and the five unit failures disappear only when those fixtures add the roster key; no change to the code will fix them.
proposed_decisions: One package, the old-rule tests.
  - Question: revise the five `test_install.py` cases and W1-04's setup probe so their fixtures set `coordination_ticket` to the orchestrator's ticket.
  - Why now: they block the guard's suite from going green on this change.
  - Options: (a) revise those fixtures; (b) keep them as they are.
  - Impact: (a) leaves the assertions as they are; (b) keeps 5 unit failures and 324 W1-04 errors.
  - Reversibility: high. Cost: small.
  - Recommendation: (a). Confidence: high.
unresolved: The acceptance run for W2-110 (it was not ready). The revision of the old-rule tests (not my decision). The adoption step (A0-A11) does not yet set `coordination_ticket`; that is outside this ticket's paths.
recommended_next_action: The lead runs `tests/acceptance/W2-110` against `da42bb59df1c` and takes the old-rule test package to the orchestrator.
